basic_details.job_title: RailTel Consultant Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: RailTel Corporation of India Limited (RailTel) has notified 3 vacancies for the post of Consultant Engineer (Contractual) on a contract basis, with applications to be submitted by post or courier to Sr. DGM/HR, RailTel Corporation of India Ltd., Northern Region, 6th Floor, Delhi IT Park, Block 3, Shastri Park on or before 13 November 2026. Eligible candidates holding a Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electronics & Telecom Engg. / Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Electrical Engg. / M.Sc. Electronics or equivalent can apply through this offline process. The notified pay

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Consultant Engineer (Contractual): Minimum 21 years, maximum 30 years. Age relaxations: OBC-NCL: 03 Years, PwBD: 10 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electronics & Telecom Engg. / Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Electrical Engg. / M.Sc. Electronics or equivalent
qualification.details: Consultant Engineer (Contractual): Bachelor's Degree in Electronics & Telecom Engg. / Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology/ Electrical Engg./M.Sc. Electronics or equivalent OR Diploma in Electronics & Telecom Engg. / Electronics Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology or equivalent. Experience: For Bachelor's Degree holder: Minimum 03 years' experience in Tunnel Communication, Railway Telecom or similar infrastructure projects. For Diploma Holder: Minimum working experience of 06 years preferably in Tunnel Communication/ Railway Telecom or similar infrastructure projects in Telecom area of Govt./Public sector.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for RailTel Consultant Engineer (Contractual) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.railtelindia.com.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RailTel Consultant Engineer (Contractual) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.railtelindia.com. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by RailTel Corporation of India Limited (RailTel) for its Northern Region projects located in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Consultant Engineer on a contractual basis for the RVNL Tunnel Project.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Consultant Engineer position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of offline applications by post or courier is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode by sending the filled application form via post or courier to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electronics & Telecom Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or M.Sc. Electronics along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of candidates should be between 21 years and 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, with permissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What salary will be provided to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary scale of Rs. 30,000 to 1,20,000 under the IDA pay structure.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a personal interview followed by a medical examination conducted by RailTel authorities.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with enclosures must be sent to Sr. DGM/HR, RailTel Corporation of India Ltd., Northern Region, 6th Floor, Delhi IT Park, Block 3, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053.
